Line x tester trial in maize

Source: R/breeding.R
maize_lxt.Rd

Simulated yields of six lines crossed with three testers, evaluated with the nine parents in three randomised complete blocks. Parents have an empty tester (lines) or an empty line (testers).

Usage

maize_lxt

Format

A data frame with 81 rows and 4 columns:

Block

Block (1-3).

Line

Line (L1-L6), NA for the tester parents.

Tester

Tester (T1-T3), NA for the line parents.

Yield_t_ha

Grain yield, t/ha.

Examples

line_tester(maize_lxt, "Yield_t_ha", "Line", "Tester", block = "Block")
